frequency_question: How often do central banks implement special incremental reserve ratio tools within a given four-month window when facing excess liquidity conditions?
membership_rule: Includes any formal central bank announcement and implementation of incremental or ad-hoc reserve requirements targeting systemic liquidity surplus. Excludes standard statutory liquidity ratio changes or regular repo rate adjustments.
window: Any four-month calendar period between 2005 and 2026.

cases.name: PBoC Reserve Requirement Ratio Hike Q1 2011

provenance_note: claims 20 cases from only 3 named (6.7x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 3 named major instances; estimated roughly 4-5 total across comparable emerging market central bank tightening cycles in similar liquidity states.
known_gaps: Excludes minor non-public fine-tuning operations and unannounced overnight interventions.
skeleton: Central bank policy meetings per year (8) over a 20-year horizon (160 meetings), identifying active liquidity-management intervention cycles.
multiplier: 3 interventions across approximately 20 relevant liquidity-surplus quarters where ad-hoc tools were plausible candidates.
validity_reason: Central bank monetary policy frameworks and liquidity management toolkits evolve slowly over multi-year horizons.
